title: Telemetry schemas and units

spans.text: Goal: apply “Telemetry schemas and units” to a real program or device. The key principle is: A schema version helps producers and consumers coordinate changes. In a project, follow this guidance: Interpret measurements with quantity, units, and calibration context.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
Example JSON telemetry record; timestamp and sensor value should come from the device at runtime.
A measurement message should carry device identity, time, value, unit, and schema version. UTC and explicit SI units make data from devices comparable.

Key line: `{"device":"sensor-12","time":"2026-01-01T12:00:00Z","value":21.4,"unit":"degC","schema":1}`
